ipeds_loc.title: IPEDS institutional directory (location, locale) via Urban Institute Education Data Portal

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class); the residency split comes from its residency table (in-state 14,512 / out-of-state 24,878 / international 3,434 applicants; 12,641 / 21,812 / 2,469 admitted; 3,339 / 1,779 / 185 enrolled). Undergraduate enrollment and the nonresident count are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures (21,031; 891 nonresidents). Nonbinding early action (closes 11/1, notified 1/10); no early decision. The GPA table is blank in the Common Data Set, so the average GPA and the GPA breakdown are not shown. The SAT middle 50% is for the 19% (1,000 students) who submitted; ACT was submitted by 1% (76 students). Temple is test optional.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2027): it says 'We are test optional.' and SAT or ACT is 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (first-year, 2026-27 update). Tuition is a weighted average because Temple has differential tuition by school/college (60% of undergraduates pay more). Only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 624 nonresidents received it (avg $17,619; total $10,994,319)
